name: List All Owners Notes
description: Returns all owner's notes that meet the filter criteria.

queryFilters.name: filters[OwnerId]
queryFilters.description: Filter by owner ID. All GET requests must include a filter for [OwnerId] or [LastUpdatedAtFrom].

queryFilters.name: filters[LastUpdatedAtFrom]
queryFilters.description: Filter notes last updated at or after this date/time. All GET requests must include a filter for [OwnerId] or [LastUpdatedAtFrom].

responseFields.name: data[].Body
responseFields.description: A brief informative message about the owner note. A owner note cannot exceed 63,535 characters.

responseFields.name: data[].EntityId
responseFields.description: The owner to which the note will be attached.

responseFields.name: data[].LastUpdatedAt
responseFields.description: The date the owner note's details were last updated.

responseFields.name: data[].Id
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the note associated with the owner.

responseFields.name: data[].NoteId
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the note associated with the owner. Deprecated in favor of Id.

responseFields.name: next_page_path
responseFields.description: The URL path to the next page of responses.
